PrintId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one print.
PrintId.title: PrintId

description: The durable identity of one debit, so that a replay can never debit twice.

oneOf.description: One segment of a print this system watched, on one tool.

segment.description:
Which segment: zero from the print's start, and one more each time
a mid-print swap or a filament-change signal closes the current one.

tool.description: The tool, in the printer's own numbering.

oneOf.description: One print this system never saw, on one tool.

generation.description:
The file's tally generation, which advances each time the printer's
tally for the file is reset.

origin.description: Where the file lives, in the printer's own vocabulary.

print_number.description:
The print's ordinal in the file's tally — completed and failed
prints counted up to and including this one — within that
generation.

tool.description: The tool, in the printer's own numbering.
